title: App manifest (app.json)
description: The manifest every app under COS_APPS_DIR must provide. The kernel validates and uses this to derive declared verbs, runtime, and capability requirements.

id.description: Stable app identifier; matches the directory name under COS_APPS_DIR.

runtime.description: Which runtime the kernel uses to invoke the entry point.

entry.description: Path relative to the app dir; python ⇒ <name>.py, binary ⇒ executable.

verbs.description: Verbs this app exposes to AI / system callers.

needs.description: Caps this verb requires before dispatch.

side_effects.description: Whether this verb mutates user-visible state — drives the kernel's mutation log decision.

scope.description: Either an inline literal scope, or { "from-arg": "<argname>" } to bind dynamically.
